threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just 'going underground'—that gives away you're fresh off the boat, mate.
Caught the 133 last night, driver had a playlist blasting classics. Even the usual drunks sang along, made the whole ride feel like a late-night party.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a spontaneous concert outside my window, just some locals jamming with a guitar and an old violin. Pure Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a bar that serves beer brewed from leftover bread. Talk about recycling in style!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their ability to navigate the bus delays; they know the secret shortcuts through the alleys that avoid the madness.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught an argument between a driver and a passenger over missing the stop—classic Muni chaos. Only in San Francisco do you get a front-row seat to public drama.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think Gràcia is just about the parks and Gaudí. They miss the little art galleries and the quiet streets where real life unfolds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them easily; they're the ones taking selfies with their tapas, oblivious to the locals who eat in silence.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think saying 'Excuse me' on the Overground will get you a polite reaction. Good luck with that!
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Clapham last week. An old bloke serenaded everyone with Elvis tunes the whole way—had us all chuckling at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the old lady in the market haggling over a single cucumber while her parrot squawked on her shoulder. That's Neukölln, alright.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a kebab place that serves currywurst-flavored kebabs. It sounds weird, but locals swear by it after a night out.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they know the exact time to avoid the 14 Mission bus after 5 PM. Those delays turn into a small eternity.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling flaming torches while waiting for the bus at Civic Center. Only in SF do you get a fire show with your transit delays.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve tapas, but the locals prefer a good bocata over pintxos any day. It’s the simple joys that keep us sane.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at how the Mercat de Gràcia closes at 2 PM on Sundays—while the rest of the neighborhood is already on tapa number three.
